bot_command_announce_description: Announce the next scheduled shift in the announcements channel.
bot_command_begin_description: Announce publicly that the shift is starting.
bot_command_complete_description: Close out the shift: clear its sign-up sheets and ask how it went.
bot_command_edit_shift_description: Set the note and server owner shown on the next shift announcement.
bot_command_option_code_description: The private server join code, if you have one.
bot_command_ping_description: Check that the bot can reach Discord and TrP Tools.
bot_command_signups_description: Post the staff sign-up sheets for the next shift.
bot_command_staff_begin_description: Tell the staff who signed up that the server is open, before announcing it publicly.
bot_command_status_description: Show what this server is configured to do, and what is coming up.
bot_common_server_only: This command only works inside a server.
bot_common_not_connected: This server is not connected to a TrP Tools group yet. A group manager can add the bot from the Bot page in the dashboard.
bot_common_unhandled: Something went wrong handling that. It has been logged.
bot_reason_no_announcement_channel: no shift announcement channel the bot can post in
bot_reason_no_host_channel: no host channel the bot can post in
bot_reason_cannot_post_in_channel: the bot cannot post in its channel
bot_announce_start_join_with_code: [Click here to join]({link}), or use the code **{code}**
bot_announce_start_servers_menu: You can also join through the servers menu in game.
bot_announce_host_open_the_room: Open the dispatch room and start the server when you are ready.
bot_staff_starting_soon: **{name}** starts {relative}. You are on it, so come in and get set up.
bot_staff_footer_running: Please keep the join code to the staff on this shift.
bot_staff_footer_early: You are in before the public announcement — please keep the code to yourselves.
bot_sheet_how_to: Pick a slot below, or sign up on the website. Both stay in step.
bot_sheet_placeholder: Choose a slot, or pick yours again to drop it
bot_signup_released: You have given up the **{slot}** slot.
bot_signup_gone: That slot no longer exists — the sheet was changed.
bot_signup_sheet_invalid: That sign-up sheet is no longer valid. Ask for a fresh one.
bot_signup_group_gone: This server is not connected to a TrP Tools group any more.
bot_signup_no_answer: TrP Tools did not answer. Try again in a moment.
bot_nothing_to_start: There is no shift running or coming up, so there is nothing to start. Add one at {link}.
bot_nothing_to_let_in: There is no shift running or coming up, so there is nobody to let in. Add one at {link}.
bot_nothing_to_edit: There is no shift running or coming up to edit. Add one at {link}.
bot_nothing_to_close: There is no shift to close out. Nothing is running, and nothing is scheduled — check the schedule at {link}.
bot_nothing_to_announce: There is no upcoming shift to announce. Add one at {link}.
bot_nothing_to_open_signups_for: There is no upcoming shift to open sign-ups for. Add one at {link}.
bot_off_announcements: Shift announcements are switched off for this group. Turn them on at {link}.
bot_off_announcements_nothing_posted: Shift announcements are switched off for this group, so nothing was posted. Turn them on at {link}.
bot_off_signups: Sign-up sheets are switched off for this group. Turn them on at {link}.
bot_off_signups_nobody: Sign-up sheets are switched off for this group, so there is nobody to let in. Turn them on at {link}.
bot_announce_command_check_channel: Set the announcement channel at {link}, and check the bot can send messages and embed links there.
bot_begin_staff_already_in: Staff who signed up were already let in.
bot_begin_staff_not_in: Staff who signed up have not been let in — run `/staff-begin` to do that.
bot_begin_board_waiting: No dispatch room is open yet — the board will appear once one is.
bot_staff_begin_no_signups_read: Could not read the sign-ups for this shift. Try again in a moment.
bot_staff_begin_no_sheets: No rank has a sign-up sheet, so nobody could have signed up. Sign-ups are per rank — add one at {link}.
bot_staff_begin_where_sheets_post: Sheets post to the channel set on each rank at {link}.
bot_staff_begin_no_code: No join code was given, so the link points at the group’s default server.
bot_staff_begin_announce_at: The public announcement is still to come — run `/begin` at {at}.
bot_staff_begin_announce_when_ready: Run `/begin` when you are ready to announce it publicly.
bot_signups_change_lead: Change how far ahead they open in group settings on the website.
bot_signups_no_sheets: No rank has a sign-up sheet set up yet. Sign-ups are per rank — add one at {link}.
bot_complete_nothing_to_clear: There was nothing left to clear.
bot_complete_clearing_off: Clearing is switched off for every channel this shift posted in.
bot_complete_kept: Left {kept} alone — those channels are set to keep their messages at {link}.
bot_complete_blocked: Could not delete {failed} of them in {where} — the bot needs **Manage Messages** and **Read Message History** there. Fix that and run `/complete` again; the messages are still tracked, so nothing is stranded.
bot_complete_polls_off: Polls are switched off for this group.
bot_complete_no_poll_channel: No poll channel is set, so no poll was posted.
bot_complete_poll_failed: Could not post the poll in {channel} — check the bot can send messages and create polls there.
bot_manifest_footer: Updates while the room is open
bot_edit_shift_note_placeholder: Shown alongside the announcement. Leave blank for none.
bot_edit_shift_owner_placeholder: Leave blank to use the group owner’s server.
bot_edit_shift_owner_not_a_number: The server owner has to be a Roblox user ID — digits only.
bot_edit_shift_refused: TrP Tools did not accept that. Try again.
bot_ping_api_unreachable: TrP Tools: **not answering for this server**
bot_ping_not_connected: Either this server is not connected to a group yet, or the API is down.
bot_status_no_sheets: *None set up. Add one per rank on the Ranks page.*
